name: free-llm-api-hub
description: A continuously-verified dataset of free-tier and trial-credit LLM API providers for developers.

scripts.test: node scripts/validate.mjs && node scripts/check-release-stamp.mjs && node scripts/check-links.mjs && node scripts/run-tests.mjs
scripts.check: node scripts/validate.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/check-generated.mjs

comment: devDependencies support JSON Schema validation, local social-image generation and reading PDF sources in the quote register (unpdf). The shipped site has zero runtime dependencies; CI installs the locked development dependencies with scripts disabled. badge-freshness.json is not committed (it is date-relative: the oldest age in days moves daily); the build writes it to site/ and every deploy publishes it — see docs/architecture.md. badge-verified.json IS a target (deterministic per dataset). The generated-file drift target list in `check` must stay in sync with the 'Generated files must be in sync with the data' step in verify.yml.
